description.en: Dispatches tasks from the main session to independent background sub-sessions, which report back automatically; a sidebar workbench shows concurrency, queueing, batch progress and failure reasons, with cancel, retry and archive. Adds 10 dispatch_* tools, zero runtime dependencies, pure ESM.
description.zh: 主会话把任务派给独立的后台子会话执行，立即返回、报告自动回流；侧边栏「派发工作台」查看并发、排队、批次进度与失败原因，可取消、重试、归档。提供 10 个 dispatch_* 工具，零运行时依赖，纯 ESM。
